comparison.adaptive_whole_inquiry: Temperature-aware direct-model CC/CV with equal ordinary telemetry, supported current tiers, geometry reconfiguration and qualification opportunities; implement only if the premise opens an inquiry.
comparison.competence: Permit every ordinary history and nominal model. If CC reaches 4.2 V, retain competent CV continuation through supported native Experiment/voltage-control interfaces; early CC stopping alone does not establish conventional failure.
comparison.failure_choice: Retain numerical, source, deadline, voltage and thermal reasons. A missing CV tail or adaptive allowed current leaves competent control unevaluated. Only a surviving consequential distinction can justify freezing a minimal supported supplier and independent assessment.
comparison.first_eligible_common_policy: Manufacturer-standard CC/CV: 1.455 A charging, live voltage/temperature/current protections, 4.2 V regulation, 50 mA termination.
comparison.meaningful_alternative: Ordinary standard CC/CV without an additional supplier, using corrected geometry. One implementation may supply distinct cost/attribution estimands.
comparison.no_retuning: If a competent common policy meets service for both preparations, close solved/non-discriminating. Do not add a harder deadline, higher charge target, extra receiver or new thermal condition to force a gap.
comparison.supplier_status: No supplier selected before consequential inadequacy. Correct geometry is initial knowledge available to all arms.

selected_service.available_ordinary_inputs: Same exact modeledV/current/volume-mean thermometer history,known source/options/parameters,initial preparation metadata and elapsed times for all policies. No privileged concentration fields/checkpoints.
selected_service.charge_origin: Exactly 1.455 × 900 / 3600 A.h: a standard-charge-equivalent 15-minute top-up chosen before outputs; 7.275% of modeled 5 Ah. No full-charge or physical efficiency claim.
selected_service.current_convention: Positive discharges;negative charges. On0<=t<900 request-1.455A. Receiver at900 observes preceding charge; end of service is not an unobservedzero-current delivery.
selected_service.engineering_choices: 900s partial-charge requirement is an explicitly chosen service.23/27C are source test bounds.Model initialSOC0.30 is idealizedOEMshipping anchor,not measured cellSOC population.

limits.current_A: Conservative OEM tier and native sign convention. Standard 1.455 A magnitude is permitted across the entire selected temperature range.
limits.risk: Deterministic simulated envelope: zero certified violations throughout 0–900 s; retain termination/refusal as failure. No population risk-confidence claim.

selected_service.prepared_state: Initialize each preparation independently at initial SOC 0.30. No prefix, supplied latent checkpoint, conditioning or outcome selection.
selected_service.question: Does ordinary standard-rate charging already supply a useful 15-minute top-up on both supported standard-test temperature preparations after geometry correction, or is a consequential charging inadequacy exposed?
